csb2-c4-e2.stdin:
THROW HttpException StatusCode=499
THROW HttpException StatusCode=500
THROW TimeoutException StatusCode=700
THROW HttpException StatusCode=404
csb2-c4-e2.expected:
Exception: HttpException (499) => Intercepte par: catch (Exception) [FallbackGlobal] | FINALLY execute
Exception: HttpException (500) => Intercepte par: catch when (StatusCode >= 500) [ServerError] | FINALLY execute
Exception: TimeoutException (700) => Intercepte par: catch (TimeoutException) [DelaiDepasse] | FINALLY execute
Exception: HttpException (404) => Intercepte par: catch when (StatusCode == 404) [ClientError] | FINALLY execute
csb2-c4-e2.raison: 499 passe au repli, 500 atteint la borne serveur, TimeoutException suit son propre catch indépendamment du code, et 404 le filtre client.
